title: Post-100 depth batch 08
notes: Bounded depth batch under Issue #253. Adds only first-party-backed lifecycle history for TokenPocket Mobile Wallet, Guarda Wallet and Cake Wallet. TokenPocket's exact 2018-02-13 release supports a separate explicit canonical launch-date correction if this candidate validates. Guarda's 2018-12-04 Mobile Multiwallet release is preserved as a later multi-currency mobile milestone and does not overwrite the earlier 2017 single-currency Guarda lineage. Cake Wallet remains at year precision because first-party history establishes 2018 but no defensible exact public-release day. Canonical publication is prohibited until candidate validation/review and a fresh exact-main promotion complete.

events.title: TokenPocket Wallet officially released
events.description: TokenPocket's first-party announcement history records the formal release of TokenPocket Wallet on 2018-02-13.
events.notes: The source provides an exact first-party formal release date. If promoted, wlr_prod_000079 can be explicitly corrected from an unresolved launch_date to 2018-02-13 with day precision; the candidate bundle itself does not mutate the existing canonical product.

events.title: Guarda Mobile Multiwallet released
events.description: Guarda released its Mobile Multiwallet on 2018-12-04 as a universal multi-coin mobile wallet, extending the earlier Guarda wallet lineage into a concrete multi-currency mobile product milestone.
events.notes: This is a later multi-currency mobile milestone, not the initial launch of the Guarda wallet lineage. Guarda's first-party history separately states that its first Ethereum wallet launched in 2017, so wlr_prod_000082 launch_date remains unresolved rather than being backdated or reset to this 2018 release.

events.title: Cake Wallet launched as a Monero wallet for iOS
events.description: Cake Wallet's first-party history states that the project started in 2018 as the first Monero wallet for iOS, establishing the selected product's public release lineage during that year.
events.notes: Year precision only. The reviewed first-party history does not establish a defensible exact public-release month or day, so the existing 2018 launch_date and year precision remain unchanged.

evidence.title: TokenPocket announcement center — TokenPocket Wallet officially released
evidence.notes: First-party TokenPocket announcement center lists the formal TokenPocket Wallet release on 2018-02-13. Used for the exact product-release event and proposed later canonical launch-date correction.

evidence.title: Mobile Multiwallet release
evidence.notes: First-party Guarda release post introducing the universal multi-coin Mobile Multiwallet on 2018-12-04. This source is not used to replace the earlier 2017 single-currency Guarda lineage.

evidence.title: About Us | Cake Wallet
evidence.notes: First-party Cake Wallet history states the project was founded in 2018 and started as the first Monero wallet for iOS. Used at year precision only.
